+/**
+ * Converts a social ID to its full URL based on the social network type.
+ * Handles vanity handles (e.g., "TutanotaTeam"), domain names (e.g., "twitter.com/username"),
+ * and full URLs (e.g., "https://twitter.com/...")
+ */
+function _getSocialUrl(socialId: ContactSocialId): string {
+	const socialIdValue = socialId.socialId.trim()
+	
+	// If already a full URL (starts with http:// or https://), return as-is
+	if (socialIdValue.startsWith("http://") || socialIdValue.startsWith("https://")) {
+		return socialIdValue
+	}
+	
+	let socialUrlType = ""
+	let http = "https://"
+	let worldwidew = "www."
+
+	switch (socialId.type) {
+		case ContactSocialType.TWITTER:
+			socialUrlType = "twitter.com/"
+			// If it already looks like a URL (contains www. or full path), don't add social URL type
+			if (socialIdValue.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1 || socialIdValue.indexOf("/") !== -1) {
+				socialUrlType = ""
+			}
+			break
+
+		case ContactSocialType.FACEBOOK:
+			socialUrlType = "facebook.com/"
+			if (socialIdValue.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1 || socialIdValue.indexOf("/") !== -1) {
+				socialUrlType = ""
+			}
+			break
+
+		case ContactSocialType.XING:
+			socialUrlType = "xing.com/profile/"
+			if (socialIdValue.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1 || socialIdValue.indexOf("/") !== -1) {
+				socialUrlType = ""
+			}
+			break
+
+		case ContactSocialType.LINKED_IN:
+			socialUrlType = "linkedin.com/in/"
+			if (socialIdValue.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1 || socialIdValue.indexOf("/") !== -1) {
+				socialUrlType = ""
+			}
+			break
+
+		case ContactSocialType.OTHER:
+		case ContactSocialType.CUSTOM:
+		default:
+			// For OTHER and CUSTOM types, just add https:// and www. if not already present
+			break
+	}
+
+	// Don't add www. if the value already contains a domain separator (/) or www.
+	if (socialIdValue.indexOf(worldwidew) !== -1 || socialIdValue.indexOf("/") !== -1) {
+		worldwidew = ""
+	}
+
+	return `${http}${worldwidew}${socialUrlType}${socialIdValue}`
+}

+
+/**
+ * Escape vCard content for URL fields.
+ * Unlike _getVCardEscaped, this does NOT escape colons since they are part of the URL scheme (e.g., https:)
+ * and RFC 6350 specifies that colons in URLs should not be escaped.
+ */
+function _getVCardEscapedForUrl(content: string): string {
+	content = content.replace(/\n/g, "\\n")
+	content = content.replace(/;/g, "\\;")
+	// Note: Do NOT escape colons in URLs - RFC 6350 specifies they should not be escaped
+	content = content.replace(/,/g, "\\,")
+	return content
+}
